_comment: wave-A4 S1 — local turnkey run mode overlay. Loaded when DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT/ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Local. Inherits the REAL working config from base appsettings.json (Network=Mainnet, the 8 EnabledTasks, ScanMempoolOnStart=true) and only flips the cookie policy for the plain-HTTP localhost front door. RavenDb URL + secrets dir are supplied by compose.local.yml env so this profile also runs on an older published image that predates this file. NEVER inline provider secrets here — the first-run wizard writes them to the secrets file at runtime; CI secrets-lint guards this.
